title: Attendance
subtitle: Daily attendance, shifts, employee history and reports.
teamSubtitle: Attendance of the departments you manage.
readOnlyNote: You have view-only access to attendance.
demoDataNote: Simulated data — check-ins and check-outs are simulated operations, and changes last only until the page is reloaded.

statusHint.scheduled: The shift has not ended and there is no check-in yet.
statusHint.incomplete: Checked in, but no check-out after the shift ended.

kpis.label: Today's attendance
kpis.presentHint: Checked in today (on time, late, half day or without check-out).
kpis.absentHint: Shift ended today without a check-in.
kpis.lateHint: Checked in after the start time plus the grace period.
kpis.rateHint: Checked in ÷ employees whose shift has ended or who checked in, excluding leave.

trend.title: Last 7 days
trend.subtitle: Attendance records per day by status

departments.title: Today by department
departments.subtitle: Checked in, late and absent per department

monthly.title: Monthly attendance
monthly.subtitle: Attendance rate and average working hours per month

records.label: Attendance records
records.search: Search by name or employee number

punch.hint: Simulated operation for this demo: the time you enter is stored as the punch. No device, location or biometric data is involved.

edit.title: Edit attendance record
edit.createHint: For work on a day without a scheduled record (e.g. a weekend). Scheduled days already have a record.
edit.checkOutHint: Leave empty if the employee has not checked out.
edit.leaveHint: This day is covered by an approved leave request (Leave Management), so no check-in or check-out can be recorded. Cancel the leave request to record attendance.

details.title: Attendance record
details.notFound: This attendance record does not exist.
details.forbidden: This record is outside your attendance access.
details.snapshotNote: Department and position as they were on this day.

shifts.label: Shifts
shifts.name: Shift
shifts.graceHint: Check-ins within this many minutes after the start are not late (0–120).
shifts.timesHint: An end time at or before the start time means the shift ends the next day.
shifts.examplesNote: Example shifts for the demo — not an official working-time policy.
shifts.noMembers: No employees are assigned to this shift.
shifts.assignHint: The new shift applies from today. Past attendance keeps the shift it was worked under.
shifts.confirmDeactivateText: The shift will no longer be available for new assignments. Existing attendance records keep it.

history.title: Attendance history
history.selectHint: Choose an employee to see their monthly attendance.
history.noRecords: No attendance records in this month.
history.inactiveEmployee: This employee is inactive; their attendance history is kept.
history.forbidden: This employee's attendance is outside your access.

reports.title: Reports
reports.exportHint: The CSV file contains every row of this report that your role may see.

validation.codeFormat: Use letters, digits and single hyphens only (for example SHF-01).
validation.invalidDateTime: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.workDaysRequired: Choose at least one working day.
validation.sameTimes: The end time must differ from the start time.
validation.shiftTooLong: A shift cannot be longer than 16 hours.
validation.breakTooLong: The break must be shorter than the shift.
validation.graceTooLong: The grace period must be shorter than the shift.

serverErrors.duplicate: This code is already used. Choose a different code.
serverErrors.not-found: The selected record no longer exists.
serverErrors.futureTime: The time cannot be in the future.
serverErrors.outsideShift: The time is too far from the scheduled shift.
serverErrors.alreadyCheckedIn: A check-in is already recorded for this shift.
serverErrors.alreadyCheckedOut: A check-out is already recorded for this shift.
serverErrors.notCheckedIn: Record the check-in before the check-out.
serverErrors.beforeCheckIn: The check-out must be after the check-in.
serverErrors.onLeave: The employee is on approved leave that day.
serverErrors.duplicateRecord: This employee already has an attendance record for that date.
serverErrors.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.
serverErrors.outsideWindow: Records can only be added within the last four months.
serverErrors.notEmployed: The employee was not employed on that date.
serverErrors.shift-in-use: Employees are assigned to this shift. Assign them another shift first.
serverErrors.pastDate: The start date cannot be in the past.
serverErrors.rangeOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.
serverErrors.rangeTooLong: Choose a period of up to three months.
